title: Sharing Thread Pools Across Bulkhead Boundaries
pattern: Using a single global thread pool for all tasks of different priorities, durations, or targets.
why_bad: If public request threads block on a slow backend, they exhaust the pool. Admin request threads are starved, meaning operations cannot log in, query metrics, or perform graceful shutdowns.
detection: Executing low-priority, slow integrations on the same Tokio runtime or thread pool as high-priority, latency-sensitive serving paths.
fix: Implement Bulkheads—separate thread pools or executors for different request classes.
